registered: 2026-10-14, before the audit code was written or run
reference: every pack CV end (pack >= 13.95 V, 0 < I < 6 A, last sample of the run) within a segment; depth(t) = Ah(CV end) - Ah(t) by integrating current_A (dt<=600 s, dt>0) until the next CV end in the same segment
run: maximal contiguous samples with current inside one band
expected_step: step_mean of the most recent program step (events.step_programs, main) with t_cv_end before the run start; if none, 32.8 Ah
coverage: run depth range must include [exp-6, exp+6] Ah
location: per cell midpoint crossing: upper window depth in [exp-6, exp-3], lower window [exp+3, exp+6], >=5 samples each; threshold = mean of the two window medians; discharge: first sample in time with depth > exp-3 and V < thr; charge: first sample in time with depth < exp+3 and V > thr; location = depth at that sample; four-cell mean if all four located
program_reproduction: runs inside a program excursion window [t_cv_end, t_measured] of events.step_programs (main) are 'program runs'; report |dynamic location - program step_mean|
additional: located crossings not inside any program excursion window
coulomb_drift: for consecutive CV ends in a segment: integrated net Ah between them (closure, ideally ~0) and counter difference (charge_Ah_cum - discharge_Ah_cum; books the 20 A pulse as charge, reported only)
exit_rule: continue to 2b only if median |program reproduction diff| <= 0.3 Ah AND median |closure| <= 0.2 Ah AND >= 5 of 7 months (month = between consecutive checkups, months 0..6) have >= 3 additional located 45 C crossings in one direction/band; otherwise diagnostic only
no_proxy_metrics: the audit computes no proxy metric
